title: Finding F-e12398b4: An unreadable or non-directory policy directory is skipped silently

question: Q-001
reason: fragments.ts lines 43-47 catch every readdir error on <module>/policy and continue, so EACCES and ENOTDIR are silently skipped like ENOENT. The spec requirement (line 63) says the loader SHALL refuse a directory or file it cannot use rather than skip it; design decision 6 and the failure cases say nothing is half-loaded and a forbid is never skipped silently. The "Nothing to load" scenario only licenses skipping a module that has no policy directory, not one whose policy directory exists and is unusable. The finding therefore stands and needs a fix.

checked.claim: Only a module with no policy path at all is allowed to contribute nothing, so ENOENT must stay distinct from other errors.

checked.quote: because a forbid must never be skipped silently
checked.claim: Design decision 6 states the intent that unusable policy entries are refused, not dropped.
